scope: Portable DecorationService, Decoration and deferred logical-line cache. Live browser rendering remains task32 and criterion245.

findings.issue: Cell iterator eagerly captured a bucket, unlike the source generator's lazy first next.
An exhausted native cell iterator could resume after later bucket growth.
Public line-bucket getter returned a copied vector instead of a live readonly source array.
findings.status: fixed with read-only DecorationBucket Rc view

findings.issue: Lazy color getter returned a cloned Color rather than shared mutable cached IColor identity.
findings.status: fixed with Rc<RefCell<Color>> handles and identity/mutation assertions

findings.issue: Oracle regenerated tracked expected fixtures during a normal check.
findings.status: fixed with default byte-exact verification and explicit --generate
